title: Downloading POLIS data
text: POLIS exposes data OData API, three quirks make naive OData client silently lose rows. polished::get_polis_data() single entry point works around three, caches results disk, resumes cleanly pull interrupted. three traps handles : Date filters year-aligned . POLIS honours field le YYYY-12-31 bound returns zero rows sub-year le. get_polis_data() aligns min_date / max_date year boundaries building filter, mid-year range never silently empties result. $skip rejected @odata.nextLink. POLIS caps $top 2000 rows refuses standard OData paging mechanism. way past 2000 rows Id-range pagination — …&$orderby=Id&$top=2000&$filter=… Id gt <last> — function , one page time. clinical date columns sparsely populated. Columns like CaseDate VirusDate NULL many historical records, filtering drops rows. function instead filters table’s update column (LastUpdateDate / UpdatedDate / Start / PublishDate), probes confirm fully populated.

what: Where the data lives, and how resume works
title: Downloading POLIS data
text: Every table fetched per-year part file cache folder, tiny metadata sidecar, merged one canonical file: part files resume marker. year independent Id-range walk flushes part every 2000-row batch, run dies mid-pull — dropped connection, Ctrl-C, OOM — next call picks Id gt max(Id) year. Worst-case lost work single -flight batch. polis_folder defaults tools::R_user_dir("polished", = "cache"), standard per-user cache location, incremental updates persist across sessions without choosing path. Pass explicit folder keep data alongside project instead: Re-running call update path. function asks POLIS current row count, compares part files already hold, : cache already covers count, skips pull entirely (just re-merging parts canonical file); otherwise walks year last cached Id forward, fetching new rows. daily cron calls get_polis_data(tables = "case") downloads full history delta thereafter. force clean re-pull instead resuming, pass force = TRUE (deletes table’s parts canonical file first).
code: <polis_folder>/data/ ├── im.rds                      # canonical, merged file you read └── .parts/im/     ├── year_2023.rds           # one part per calendar year     ├── year_2023.meta.rds      # row count + Id range sidecar     └── year_2024.rds polished::get_polis_data(tables = "im", polis_folder = "data/polis")

title: Recovering geography from EPIDs
text: Surveillance extracts rarely complete. pull often contain: rows fully geocoded — country, province, district, matching GUIDs present; rows admin geography missing — still carry EPID. EPID structured case identifier, conventionally COUNTRY-PROVINCE-DISTRICT-YEAR-SERIAL (e.g. NIE-BOR-MMC-24-001). leading three characters country code; next segments province district abbreviations. even names blank, EPID still encodes case . whole idea: one row tells us code NIE-BOR-MMC means Maiduguri, Borno, Nigeria, can carry geography every row whose EPID shares code — without ever inventing place data doesn’t already vouch . polished::impute_geo_from_epid() exactly triangulation. kind messy input built : Five rows missing district (four GUID); one missing country. gap recoverable different kind evidence — one two deliberately recoverable, can see function sure.

title: Recovering geography from EPIDs
text: result named list four elements: $data original data frame, unchanged except blank cells filled, plus one new <column>_source column every level touched. companion column audit trail: records cell got value. Every <col>_source factor levels: Reading district column , row row: …MMC-24-014 …JER-24-021 filled prefix_match — sibling case district (JER donor year earlier, reached set year_window = 1). …MMC-24-001CC, contact, filled self_ref: contacts reuse case’s EPID trailing marker, collapses onto case 001 inherits district. …DAM-24-009 unresolved: NIE-YOB-DAM code points two different districts donors (Damaturu Potiskum), function refuses guess. …KAN-XYZ-24-001 unresolved : nothing else data shares prefix, external reference given. two key guarantees visible : present value never overwritten (everything started district still reads original), ambiguous unsupported gap never invented — stays NA labelled unresolved, silent fabrication impossible. Admin0 tells story different strategy: Angola row country name; country_prefix recovered AGO code via crosswalk. $qa reconciliation table. one row per column function tried fill, accounts every missing cell. Column column: counts always reconcile — every missing cell either filled exactly one strategy left unresolved: n_ambiguous diagnostic, separate bucket: ambiguous cell also counted n_unresolved (missing stayed missing). broken can tell “evidence” apart “conflicting evidence” — latter manual review better reference table pays . fill sibling rows, function first builds -recent-per-EPID lookups. hands back $ref can audit considered authoritative: row one EPID recent non-blank value seen . table powers self_ref step; inspecting quickest way see given EPID resolved way . $meta records exactly run configured — useful logging pipeline result reproducible.

title: Download POLIS tables — get_polis_data
text: canonical entry point fetching data POLIS OData service. Works around three POLIS quirks make naive OData clients silently lose data: Date filters year-aligned . POLIS honours field le YYYY-12-31 bounds; sub-year le returns 0 rows. function aligns min_date / max_date year boundaries building filter. @odata.nextLink $skip rejected. POLIS caps $top 2000 refuses paginate via OData standard mechanism. way walk past 2000 rows Id-range pagination: $orderby=Id&$top=2000&$filter=... Id gt <last>. clinical date columns (CaseDate, VirusDate, ...) NULL coverage historical records. function filters table's "update" column (LastUpdateDate / UpdatedDate / Start / PublishDate) probes confirmed 100%-populated.

title: Download POLIS tables — get_polis_data
code: get_polis_data(   tables = NULL,   min_date = "2000-01-01",   max_date = Sys.Date(),   region = "Global",   country_code = NULL,   polis_folder = tools::R_user_dir("polished", which = "cache"),   return = c("invisible", "auto", "df", "list", "paths"),   output_format = c("rds", "rda", "csv", "parquet", "qs2"),   workers = 1L,   auto_refetch = TRUE,   log_file = NULL,   keep_archives = 0L,   force = FALSE,   polis_api_key = Sys.getenv("POLIS_API_KEY"),   quiet = FALSE )

title: Download POLIS tables — get_polis_data
text: tables Optional character vector table names (see polis_tables_mapping supported set). NULL (default) downloads eight tables. Unknown names abort list valid names. min_date Earliest date fetch. Defaults "2000-01-01". POLIS rejects sub-year date ranges, aligned January 1 year. max_date Latest date fetch. Defaults Sys.Date(). Aligned December 31 year. region region filter ("Global" (default), "AFRO", "AMRO", "EMRO", "EURO", "SEARO", "WPRO"). country_code Optional ISO3 country code (e.g. "NGA"). Adds CountryISO3Code eq '<code>' clause. Default NULL (country filter). polis_folder Root folder cached data. Files land <polis_folder>/data/. Default tools::R_user_dir("polished", = "cache") – standard per-user cache location, persistent across sessions incremental updates "just work". Pass explicit path keep data alongside project. return One "invisible" (default – return value; data disk), "auto" (data.frame single table, named list data.frames multiple), "df" (force single data.frame; errors multi-table calls), "list" (always named list), "paths" (named character vector file paths, data read memory). output_format Output format. One "rds" (default), "rda", "csv", "parquet", "qs2". "parquet" requires arrow package; "qs2" requires qs2 package. workers Number parallel workers. 1 (default) runs sequential loop live per-batch progress bar. > 1 opts PSOCK cluster dispatches one year per worker; pass e.g. parallel::detectCores() - 1L use cores. auto_refetch TRUE (default), run metadata-aware verification + selective refetch end table. Set FALSE trust whatever disk. log_file Optional path per-batch log file (.rds). Default NULL. keep_archives > 0, save also writes timestamped copy data/archive/ prunes older copies. Default 0 (archive). force TRUE, deletes .parts/<table>/ directory canonical file selected table running – forces fresh full re-pull instead resuming. Default FALSE. polis_api_key API key. Defaults Sys.getenv("POLIS_API_KEY"). quiet Suppress headers, progress bars, info alert. Default FALSE.

title: Download POLIS tables — get_polis_data
text: Depends return: "invisible" (default) – invisible NULL. Data disk. "auto" – data.frame length(tables) == 1, named list data.frames otherwise. "df" – single data.frame (errors one table selected). "list" – named list data.frames, one per selected table. "paths" – named character vector canonical file paths. Side effect: writes <polis_folder>/data/<table_name>.<ext> plus .parts/<table_name>/ cache selected table.

title: Download POLIS tables — get_polis_data
text: Cache layout. table fetched per-year part file <polis_folder>/data/.parts/<table_name>/year_YYYY.<ext>, tiny year_YYYY.meta.rds sidecar capturing row count min/max Id. years finish parts merged canonical <polis_folder>/data/<table_name>.<ext>. part files kept next call can resume per-year max(Id) without re-fetching. force clean re-pull, pass force = TRUE delete .parts/. Resume semantics. part files resume marker. previous run died (network blip, Ctrl-C, OOM), next call picks Id gt max(Id_in_part) year. Worst case lost work: recent -flight batch. Parallelism. calendar year min_date max_date independent Id-range walk. workers > 1, years dispatched across parallel::makePSOCKcluster() cluster (transport Windows, macOS, Linux, user can opt ); live cli progress bar polls part files socket reads see rows accumulate across workers real time. workers = 1, single sequential loop drives bar per 2K-row batch. PSOCK workers need polished installed library path – devtools::load_all() enough. Auto-refetch. auto_refetch = TRUE (default) function uses meta sidecars detect gaps cheaply (row-count Id-range mismatch POLIS's @odata.count). gap detected issue $select=Id probe refetch missing rows via OData Id (...) chunks. title: Recover administrative geography from the EPID — impute_geo_from_epid
text: data Non-empty data frame carrying EPID column. epid_var EPID column name. Default "epid". year_var Year/onset column name. Default "yronset". admin0_var, admin1_var, admin2_var Admin name columns; NULL skips level. Defaults "place.admin.0"/.1/.2. guid_vars Named character vector mapping levels (adm0/adm1/ adm2) GUID columns fill. Default c(adm2 = "Admin2GUID"); set NULL fill GUIDs. reference Optional external table (keyed epid prefix) admin names/GUIDs, data names . Default NULL. country_ref Optional country code -> name/ISO3 crosswalk. Default NULL. strategies Ordered subset c("self_ref", "prefix_match", "reference", "country_prefix"). Default uses four. prefix_length Prefix length prefix-matching. Default 11. year_window Allowed +/- year distance prefix-matching. Default 0. sep EPID segment delimiter. Default "-". canonicalise Whether canonicalise filled name cells canonicaliser available. Default TRUE. verbose Whether print cli summary. Default TRUE.
